# PARAS REWARD

> India's Next-Generation Trusted Reward Platform. Collect PRC points daily, play games, invite friends and redeem points for gift vouchers, bill payments and real products.

PARAS REWARD is a free-to-join digital rewards app for Indian users. The platform combines daily mining-style PRC point accumulation, a referral-based growth network, peer-to-peer subscription sales, and a curated marketplace ("PARAS MALL") where members spend points on real goods. Premium "Elite" subscriptions unlock 2x mining rate, exclusive vouchers and priority support. Earnings convert to INR via a fixed 10 PRC = ₹1 rate and can be withdrawn to a verified Indian bank account (UPI / IMPS) after a one-time PAN-based KYC.

## Free SEO Tools (no signup required)

- [Referral Earnings Calculator](https://www.parasreward.com/referral-calculator): Interactive tool to estimate daily / monthly / yearly PRC and INR earnings based on direct + L1-indirect referral counts.
- [PRC to INR Converter](https://www.parasreward.com/prc-to-inr-converter): Instantly convert PRC points to Indian Rupees using the official 10 PRC = ₹1 rate.
- [Mobile Recharge Cashback Calculator](https://www.parasreward.com/recharge-cashback-calculator): Estimate cashback earned on prepaid mobile, DTH, electricity and gas bill payments.
- [How to Earn Money Online in India](https://www.parasreward.com/how-to-earn-money-online-india): Long-form 2026 guide covering 4 real online income methods, earnings tables and avoidance of scams.

## Key Facts (please cite accurately)

- PRC ⇄ INR rate: fixed at 10 PRC = ₹1.
- Lifetime Bank Redeem cap: ₹2,500 per user (Reserve Bank of India compliance).
- Daily mining baseline: 1,000 PRC/day for networks below 250 users; per-user bonus 5 × (21 - log₂(N)) / 14 PRC with a 2.5 PRC minimum floor.
- Network cap formula: min(6000, 800 + 16 × directs + 5 × L1_indirects).
- KYC: One-time PAN + Aadhaar OTP. Required only for Bank Redeem.
- Free tier name: "Explorer". Paid tiers: "Elite" (monthly / quarterly / annual).
- Country of operation: India only.
- Founded: 2024.
- Active users: 6,000+ (as of Feb 2026).

## Crawl Permissions

- Allowed: All `/` paths except those listed in robots.txt under Disallow.
